caption:
The cheapest growth in your business isn't a new channel. It's answering the leads you already paid for, faster.

Everyone wants the new thing. New platform, new tool, new agency. It feels like progress because it's a purchase.

Meanwhile last month's leads are sitting in a phone, written off after one attempt.

Those people already raised their hand. You already paid to put them there. Working them properly costs almost nothing and pays immediately.

Three things that cost zero and change the month:
→ Decide who replies while you're on a job
→ Reply in minutes, not hours
→ Try more than once before writing someone off

📌 Send this to the partner who wants to launch on a new platform before the current one is even running properly.

Free 20-minute audit in bio.
